originalIndependentReview.rationale: Read complete cached Nobel API records for every claimed person/prize and CC0 terms. Reviewed institutional association to accepted frameworks: Strasbourg1909 German Empire, Calcutta1930 British India, Tunis1928 French protectorate, Moscow USSR Soviet Union, Heidelberg1954 Federal Republic.
